confirmation.subject: Confirm Your Email Address
confirmation.heading: {{appName}}
confirmation.title: Welcome!
confirmation.body: Thank you for signing up for {{appName}}! To complete your registration and activate your account, please confirm your email address by clicking the button below:
confirmation.linkText: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
confirmation.expiration: This link will expire in {{hours}} hours.

features.title: Once you confirm your email, you'll be able to:

footer.ignore: If you didn't create an account with {{appName}}, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset Your Password
passwordReset.heading: {{appName}}
passwordReset.title: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your {{appName}} account. If you made this request, click the button below to create a new password:
passwordReset.linkText: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
passwordReset.expiration: This link will expire in {{minutes}} minutes.

securityNotice.title: Security Notice:
securityNotice.body: For your protection, this password reset link can only be used once and will expire soon.

footer.ignore: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not be changed.
footer.contact: If you're concerned about your account security, please contact our support team.

emailChange.subject: Confirm Your Email Address Change
emailChange.heading: {{appName}}
emailChange.title: Confirm Email Address Change
emailChange.body: We received a request to change the email address for your {{appName}} account to {{email}}.
emailChange.instruction: To complete this change and update your account, please click the button below:
emailChange.linkText: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
emailChange.expiration: This link will expire in {{minutes}} minutes.

important.title: Important:
important.body: After confirming this email change, you will need to log in again using your new email address. All existing sessions will be invalidated for security purposes.

footer.ignore: If you didn't request this email change, please ignore this email and contact our support team immediately.
footer.noChange: Your account email will not be changed unless you click the confirmation link above.

common.needHelp: Need help? Contact us at support@example.com
